items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I didn't meet him but I was in Los Angeles at the time... I caught the last part of the movie... Art Tatum, that's all he said.

ctx.x: Did you have anybody that you liked as a pianist, that you listened to a lot?

Oh man, I like Oscar Peterson, man. I was crazy about Oscar Peterson. I saw the greatest piano player in the world, Teddy Wilson. Not Teddy Wilson. He was good. I met him down here in New Orleans. But his blind, Art Tatum.
